source: uf2 (b772): uw2's in-game review of the selectable 2026 alternate, throwback and Rivalries kits against dated 2025/26 club photos, each finding checked by uf2 against the crop, the game frame, the dated photo and the decoded native texture
method: Vector art in native texel coordinates drawn at 4x (exact integer arithmetic) and averaged onto the existing native pixels; inner rings and outside halos measured from the art; stamps of art already in the same kit; palette-only recolours; cleared shoulder digits; the Unif facemask colour. Existing palette plus spare slots, wet_93 mud twin, fixed spans.
